newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close lower, but climb off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close lower, but climb off lows.

text.p: Jan 24 - U.S. debt futures closed lower, but climbed off session lows on light short-covering. March T-bonds failed to break through the 2-1/2-mos low of 109-26/32, which is also the bottom of the market's 2-1/2-week range. Traders are awaiting Tuesday's 4Q employment cost index report.
